test.description: fill-extrusion cast-shadows bias contact proof (§3.12.3). A low sun (polar 30deg) throws a long ground shadow from the tall tower; with the shipped bias (constant 0, slope 0.05, per-cascade 8x/4x) the cast shadow MEETS the tower wall base with no peter-panning gap, and the roofs carry no grazing-sun acne. A/B (documented, not renderable as a style knob because the bias constants are hard-coded shader uniforms, not style properties): a nonzero constant bias detaches the shadow from the wall base (peter-panning), a zero slope bias reintroduces roof acne (proven live in Task 5's first-light debug: 10x slope bias was a no-op until v_slope was fixed to a normalized light direction, then the shipped 0.05 discriminated correctly). This golden is the shipped-bias contact evidence.
